title: Astralyte Mayhem
description: A rare endgame ore found deep below the world.
body:
🌌 Astralyte

A rare end-game ore found deep below the world. Astralyte glows with blue-violet energy and grants powerful gravitational abilities. Use it to craft unique tools, weapons, and armor that bend gravity, reduce fall damage, and even teleport mined blocks directly into your inventory. Combine fragments to create the mysterious Astral Core and unlock dimensional secrets.
